indicators.note: the answer is wrapped up inside the single word membership, so involved in points to letters lying within it

explanation.surface: Something lingering on among the members of a club.
explanation.walkthrough: 'involved in' tells you the answer sits inside 'membership': mEMBERShip.
explanation.definitionFit: Embers are what is left of a fire after it has burned down, its glowing remains.

indicators.note: vandalising wrecks the words, so their letters are mixed into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Someone defacing restaurant menus with oil paint.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Vandalise' rearranges MENUS together with OIL; 'oil paint' is a false phrase, as only 'paint' defines.
explanation.definitionFit: Emulsion is a water-based paint commonly used on interior walls.

clue.text: Operatic singing can buckle without love

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside means the belt wraps around the can

parts.note: to buckle is to fasten, as one does a belt
taken as written
love is zero in tennis, which looks like the letter O

explanation.surface: Opera singing that can make you weak at the knees without love.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' is used in its old sense of outside, so it signals containment. 'buckle' misleads as 'collapse' but means fasten.
explanation.definitionFit: Bel canto, Italian for beautiful singing, is the lyrical operatic vocal style of Bellini and Donizetti.

indicators.note: headless means the word for the fish loses its first letter

parts.note: a trout is a freshwater fish

explanation.surface: Finishing off a fish that has had its head removed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Polish off' sounds like eating the fish; it means defeat utterly.
explanation.definitionFit: To rout an enemy is to defeat them completely, to polish them off.

clue.text: Blow hard on pen before finally writing inscription

indicators.note: before places the pen piece ahead of the closing letter of the word writing
on here means added after, so the blow-hard pair is attached behind the pen and writing pieces

parts.note: an EpiPen is an adrenaline injector pen, so pen suggests EPI

indicators.note: finally picks the closing letter of the word writing

parts.note: a rap is a sharp blow or knock
H is the pencil-grading abbreviation for hard

explanation.surface: A forceful instruction to press down hard with your pen before finishing an inscription.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' and 'before' set the order: the blow-hard pair comes last. The pen is an EpiPen, a brand of adrenaline injector.
explanation.definitionFit: An epigraph is a short quotation or inscription placed on a building, statue or at the head of a book.

indicators.note: out means put out of order, so the letters of the three words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A dark-haired woman being stretched out or upset.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' rearranges A BRUNETTE PUT.
explanation.definitionFit: Peanut butter is a paste spread on bread, a spread in the food sense.

clue.text: Loses interest in missing mushrooms first

indicators.note: first tells us the mushrooms piece leads, coming before the missing piece

parts.note: to mushroom is to grow rapidly
out of, as in out of milk, means lacking or missing

explanation.surface: Someone loses enthusiasm when the mushrooms go missing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mushrooms' is a verb here, not the food; 'first' puts GROWS before OUT OF.
explanation.definitionFit: You grow out of a hobby or habit when, with age, it no longer appeals to you.

indicators.note: arrested means held, so the word for when holds the man inside it

parts.note: as can mean when, as in as I left
gent is short for gentleman, a man

explanation.surface: Secret agents watch as a man is taken into custody.
explanation.definitionFit: Agents are operatives of an intelligence service, i.e. spies.

parts.note: something hung is suspended
RY is an abbreviation for railway, the trains

explanation.surface: Someone yearning for trains that have been cancelled or put on hold.
explanation.walkthrough: 'suspended' reads as halted services but means hanging.
explanation.definitionFit: Hungry has the figurative sense of eager or longing, as in hungry for success.

indicators.note: destroying the word mutual breaks its letters apart so they can be rebuilt in another order

explanation.surface: A reference to mutually assured destruction, the Cold War nuclear doctrine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mark for mutual destruction' reads as the Cold War phrase; 'destruction' is the anagram signal, rearranging MUTUAL.
explanation.definitionFit: An umlaut is the two-dot diacritic placed over a vowel, as in German, a written mark.

clue.text: This Frenchman's not capturing a location in the Arctic circle?

indicators.note: capturing means the word for not takes the other pieces prisoner inside it

parts.note: non is French for not, the clue's Frenchman supplying the language
the North Pole lies within the Arctic Circle

explanation.surface: A question whether some Frenchman is reluctant to take a place in the far north.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Frenchman's' tells you to put 'not' into French. The question mark admits the North Pole is a loose 'location in the Arctic circle'.
explanation.definitionFit: Napoleon Bonaparte, French emperor, is the archetypal famous Frenchman.

definitions.meaning: an idiom meaning eventually or in the end
a marathon is a long race, so a runner in one is literally ...

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means over time or eventually, while read literally it places a runner in a lengthy race.

parts.note: S is the standard abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels
a can is a container like a pail or bucket

explanation.surface: Plunging something into a little pail.
explanation.definitionFit: To scan a book is to look through it quickly, browsing or dipping into it.

clue.text: Question is welcomed separately by Eskimo or Torquemada?

indicators.note: separately says the two welcomed pieces do not sit side by side but are parted by a letter of the Eskimo
welcomed means taken in, so the Eskimo holds the question and is pieces inside it

parts.note: an Inuit is a member of the Arctic people once called Eskimo
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A puzzled question about whether an Arctic native or the Spanish Grand Inquisitor asked something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'welcomed' puts the two pieces inside the Arctic people; 'separately' parts them, one either side of its U, shown as that U moving. Torquemada was the first Grand Inquisitor of the Spanish Inquisition.
explanation.definitionFit: Torquemada is the most notorious example of an inquisitor; the question mark flags definition by example.

parts.note: afters is British slang for dessert or pudding
to have can mean to contain, as a box has six eggs

explanation.surface: Desserts that include a perfumed cream.
explanation.walkthrough: Afters is British informal for the pudding course after the main meal; 'contain' looks like an insertion signal but is a plain synonym.
explanation.definitionFit: Aftershave is a scented lotion men apply to the face after shaving.

definitions.meaning: fish emerge from the blue sea, read literally as the answer
an idiom for suddenly and without warning

explanation.surface: Fish appearing without warning from the ocean.
explanation.definitionFit: The blue is a poetic name for the sea, and the idiom means arising suddenly, without warning.

clue.text: Trajectory to return a high shot with a smash

indicators.note: return means go back, so the string of pieces is read from the end to the start

parts.note: a lob is a high arching shot in tennis
a rap is a sharp blow, a smash

explanation.surface: Tennis advice: send back a lob with an overhead smash.
explanation.walkthrough: 'return' reverses ALOBARAP. 'return', 'high shot' and 'smash' all sound like tennis.
explanation.definitionFit: A projectile such as a lobbed ball follows a parabola, the curve of its trajectory.

clue.text: Digest most of dessert with success

indicators.note: most of means the word for the dessert loses its last letter

parts.note: syllabub is a creamy dessert of whipped cream and wine
S is a common abbreviation for success

explanation.surface: Eating nearly all of a pudding, happily.
explanation.walkthrough: SYLLABUB is an old British dessert of cream whipped with wine or sherry. 'Digest' looks like eating it, but it is a noun meaning summary.
explanation.definitionFit: A syllabus is an outline or summary of a course, as a digest is a summary.

clue.text: Raising interest rates might be no fairy tale ending for undercapitalised organisation

indicators.note: ending for picks the final letter of the word undercapitalised
organisation means arranging, so the gathered letters are put into a fresh order

explanation.surface: An economics remark that higher rates will not have a happy ending for a weak company.
explanation.walkthrough: 'organisation' looks like the company in the story; it is the anagram signal, rearranging NO FAIRY TALE plus D.
explanation.definitionFit: Higher interest rates reduce the money supply and push prices down, so they are a deflationary policy.

definitions.meaning: to champ is to chew or bite noisily
short for champions, who defend or guard a cause

explanation.definitionFit: A horse champs at its bit when chewing, and a champion is a defender or protector of a cause.

definitions.meaning: a city ... when it surrenders to an enemy

clue.text: Balance tea cup until echo from bomb ends

explanation.surface: Keeping your teacup steady until the blast has died away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from ... ends' takes the last letters of 'tea cup until echo from bomb'. 'Balance' looks like steadying the cup.
explanation.definitionFit: Aplomb is calm self-possession, and balance in the sense of mental composure.

indicators.note: blending mixes the letters of the two words up together into a new order

explanation.surface: A cooking tip: add flavour by mixing it into the vegetables.
explanation.walkthrough: 'blending' is the anagram signal, rearranging SEASON BY.
explanation.definitionFit: Soya beans are legumes, eaten as vegetables, from which tofu and soy sauce are made.
